title: Hired before 2017
statementMd:
List employees hired before 2017-01-01, with their hire date.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `hire_date`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE hire_date < '2017-01-01';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
